_source: ResourceGraphCommon.ErrorResponse (https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azureresourcegraph/resourcegraph/resources/resources?view=rest-azureresourcegraph-resourcegraph-2024-04-01#resourcegraphcommon.errorresponse): error.code, error.message and error.details[] of {code, message}. The support-info message and the InvalidQuery detail are as ARG writes them (https://learn.microsoft.com/answers/a/1937621). The REST reference doesn't document a detail's line, characterPositionInLine and token: they are the parser detail as the Azure CLI prints it, not recorded from a tenant. The test fills in {line} and {position} (0-based within the line).

error.message: Please provide below info when asking for support: timestampUtc = 2026-10-21T08:00:00.0000000Z, correlationId = 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

details.message: Query is invalid. Please refer to the documentation for the Azure Resource Graph service and fix the error before retrying.
